translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Sessoaton Jesus
Iwe Espritu a paeninoa Jesus noan desert we pwe epwe noa sessoat me reen Saetan.
Nge mwirin aaen Jesus aecchigipin noan faaeig raaen me faaeig pwoong, iwe a meyaefi aan pecchai.
Iwe, Saetan we a itto reen nge a aengaeni pwe, “Aere een Naiun Deus, wopwe aengaeniir faai kaan pwe repwe ssiuwen ngaeni fenoawa.”
Nge Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa pwe, ‘Saapw fenoawa rhag minne aeremas repwe menaw reen, pwe re menaw reen oanongaen kkepas kka Deus a aepesa.’ ”
Iwe Saetan we a paeninoa Jesus Jerusalem, aepinoamw we e santus, nge a noa aiuwtae pwiuneoi we oarosaen taegias me reen Temple we.
Iwe, a aengaeni pwe, “Aere een Naiun Deus, wa oatoroagotiw me igeei, pwe Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa pwe,

content.text: ‘Deus epwe akkiuneeor naiun angkenus repwe aemmwenoag.
pwe pirhemw mwo nge ete woas ngaeni faai.’ ”

content: Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Pwapwior we e Santus epwan aepesa pwe, ‘Wosoapw soatoni Deus na oamw Soamwoon.’ ”
Mwirin Saetan we a pwan paenitae Jesus wooan eew rhug igin taegias nge a pwaeri ngaeni mweoiun feoniufan me oanongaen minikkena nningen.
Iwe, a aengaeni Jesus pwe, “Oanongaen minikkeei ipwe ngaenneog, aere wopwe foatotiw me weni mmwaei nge wa oassotupw ngaeniaei.”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Siunoa Saetan! Pwe Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa pwe, ‘Wopwe oassotupw ngaeni Deus na oamw Soamwoon nge iiy rhag wopwe engaang ngaeni.’ ”
Iwe rhag nge Saetan we a siusaengi Jesus, iwe nge angkenus ra itto tipaengi.
Jesus a Rhaepiy Tae Aan Engaang Noan Galilee
Igiwe Jesus a rongorong pwe ra iseni nong John noan kanepwus, iiy a noa Galilee.
Ese notiw noan Nazareth, pwe a noa no noan Capernaum, eew aepinoamw oaron meoneoiniuniun Galilee noan faniuwaen Zebulun me Naphtali.
A feeori minneen pwe epwe nnet miniwe profeta Isaiah e aepesa pwe,

content.text: wooan aanna enoa ngaeni eew meoneoiniun,
me Galilee, faniuweer rhooawe re Gentiles!
nge rhooakkena reno noan rorhappiungiun faniuwaen mae
ina eew seram epwene ttinitiw wooar.”

content: Saengi iiy oatowe nge Jesus a rhaepiy tae aan fenai, “Oawpwe toagun saengi monofitimi, pwe Mweoiu Naaeng a arapeto!”
Jesus a Faingiir Faaman Rhooan Fita
Nipwaen aaen Jesus a faaeraeg ngaerhei meoneoiniuniun Galilee, a weriir riiurhai rhooan fita nge re pwipwi, Simon (pwan itan Peter) me Andrew iwe pwiin, rewuug fetaen iig noan iiy meoneoiniun we.
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw itto tapweaei pwe ipwe oasuguuna ngaenigaemi wunuunun aaemi oawpwe fita aeremas.”
Oatowe rhag nge ra siusaengi wuug kkewe aar nge ra tapweei noa mwirin.

Jesus a pwan faaeraeg noa nge a pwan weriir riiurhai mwaaen pwipwi, James me John, ikkiwe naiun Zebedee. Reno wooan pwoot we waar reen mwaaen we semeer Zebedee, re aemmwena wow wuug kkewe aar. Iwe nge Jesus a faingiir.
Oatowe rhag nge ra siusaengi pwoot we waar me mwaaen we semeer nge re tapweei noa mwirin.
Jesus e Fenai me Aecchipwaar Aeremas

Iwe, Jesus a mwet fetaen wooan oanongaen Galilee, nge e fenai me noan wutteer Jews we nge e fenaiuw Kkepas Mwamwaai we reen Mweoiu Naaeng, me pwan aecchipwaar aeremas kkewe eweriir mesemesaen semwaai.

Kkepesaen Jesus a rheeoi noa wooan oanongaen faniuwaen Syria, iwe aeremas ra pweipwog to oanongeer rhooa semwaai reen, rhooakka eweriir mesemesaen semwaai me metaeg, aeremas kka waen aniu, man ngong me aeremas kka re maemerhoar. Iwe, Jesus a aecchipwaar tae oanongeer.
Re towunap aeremas kka rettapw mwirin Jesus saengi Galilee me Decapolis, saengi Jerusalem me Judea me faniuw we eno epeig me reen pwupwu we Jordan.
